posts.text: DOF Group ASA - Contract extension Close i dag kl. 12:04 ∙ Oslo Børs DOF Group ASA ("DOF") is pleased to announce that the CSV Skandi Nomad has had a 12-month option declared. The contract is now firm until November 2027. The value of the option period is Limited*. *DOF defines a Limited contract as a contract with value below USD 15 million. Contact information: Eirik Vardøy, Investor Relations DOF Group ASA Phone: +47 94 83 64 64
